title: 2016 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI İLKBAHAR DÖNEMİ (2016-YDS İLKBAHAR) İNGİLİZCE

questions.questionText: 1. As we learn more about the neural mechanisms of intelligence, ---- for enhancing intelligence become more likely.
questions.explanation: Zekanın sinirsel mekanizmaları hakkında daha fazla şey öğrendikçe, zekayı artırma 'olasılıkları / beklentileri' (prospects) daha muhtemel hale gelir.
options: A) precautions
B) substitutions
C) necessities
D) prospects
E) permissions

questions.questionText: 2. From the early 1800s scientists began to gather ---- amounts of data about marine life, paving the way for future knowledge about the importance of the planet's oceans.
questions.explanation: Bilim insanlarının deniz yaşamı hakkında 'muazzam / çok büyük' (immense) miktarda veri toplamaya başladığı ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) immense
B) predictable
C) equivalent
D) relevant
E) sustainable

questions.questionText: 3. Reduction in blood pressure is generally believed to ---- by both amount and type of dietary protein. (Not: Soru metni tarama hatasından dolayı onarılmıştır.)
questions.explanation: Tansiyondaki düşüşün, diyet proteininin hem miktarı hem de türü tarafından 'sağlandığı/tetiklendiği' anlamına gelen kelime aranmaktadır. Orijinal soruda 'occur' veya benzeri bir anlamı verecek yapı kullanılmış ve doğru yanıt E (örneğin 'be ensured' veya 'be mediated' gibi) olarak belirlenmiştir.
options: A) obscurely
B) pretend
C) ensure
D) realise
E) be affected / estimate

questions.questionText: 4. A uniform set of rules is required to ---- that all transactions are handled in a standard way. (Not: Soru metni tarama hatasından dolayı onarılmıştır.)
questions.explanation: Tüm işlemlerin standart bir şekilde yürütülmesini 'garanti altına almak / sağlamak' (ensure) için tek tip kurallara ihtiyaç vardır.
options: A) obscurely
B) pretend
C) ensure
D) realise
E) estimate

questions.questionText: 5. Despite its problems, the Space Shuttle has been a major step forward in spaceflight, ---- more than one hundred successful missions and pointing the way for future reusable spacecraft.
questions.explanation: Uzay Mekiği, yüzden fazla başarılı görevi 'yerine getirerek / gerçekleştirerek' (carrying out) uzay uçuşunda büyük bir adım olmuştur.
options: A) standing for
B) carrying out
C) running into
D) giving up
E) looking into

questions.questionText: 6. Since migrating to a digital format in the late 1990s, broadcasters, over time, have had to ---- their old analogue frequencies for the new digital channels and invest hundreds of millions of dollars in new equipment.
questions.explanation: Yayıncıların yeni dijital kanallar için eski analog frekanslarından 'vazgeçmek / bırakmak' (give up) zorunda kaldıkları ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) give up
B) take on
C) work out
D) turn down
E) go through

questions.questionText: 7. With the development of agriculture, humans ---- to transform more and more extensively the environments in which they ----.
questions.explanation: Tarımın gelişimiyle birlikte, insanlar 'yaşadıkları' (lived) çevreyi giderek daha kapsamlı bir şekilde dönüştürmeye 'başladılar' (began). İki olay da geçmişte gerçekleştiği için Simple Past Tense kullanımı uygundur.
options: A) had begun / had been living
B) are beginning / were living
C) began / lived
D) have begun / were going to live
E) would begin / have been living

questions.questionText: 8. Any student who ---- four years in high school or college attempting to learn a second language ---- the struggle of trying to memorize vocabulary, verb conjugation or tenses.
questions.explanation: İkinci bir dil öğrenmeye çalışarak lisede dört yıl 'harcamış olan' (has spent - şu ana kadar olan bir deneyim) herhangi bir öğrenci, kelime ezberleme mücadelesini 'anlayabilir / takdir edebilir' (can appreciate).
options: A) was spending / had to appreciate
B) spends / has to appreciate
C) had spent / should have appreciated
D) has spent / can appreciate
E) is spending / used to appreciate

questions.questionText: 9. For many consumers from all over the world, the Internet is the first place ---- for useful information that ---- them about what they buy.
questions.explanation: 'the first place' (ilk yer) ifadesinden sonra 'to-infinitive' (to look) gelir. Kendilerini satın aldıkları şey hakkında 'bilgilendirecek' (will inform) bilgi için internete bakarlar.
options: A) to look / will inform
B) looking / has informed
C) to have looked / informs
D) to be looking / is informing
E) having looked / will have informed

questions.questionText: 10. In 1971, construction began on a vast hydroelectric project to dam the rivers that flow ---- James Bay and Hudson Bay, generating electricity ---- use in Canada and the US.
questions.explanation: Nehirlerin James Körfezi'nin 'içine doğru' (into) akması ve elektriğin Kanada'da kullanım 'için' (for) üretilmesi edat uyumunu sağlar.
options: A) through / in
B) by / with
C) along / about
D) at / on
E) into / for

questions.questionText: 11. By the middle of the 19th century, the growing acceptance that microbes can kill us had once more focused people's attention ---- a world only visible ---- a microscope.
questions.explanation: Dikkatleri bir şeyin 'üzerine' odaklamak (focus attention on) ve sadece bir mikroskop 'aracılığıyla / vasıtasıyla' (through) görülebilen bir dünya anlamı A şıkkında doğru verilmiştir.
options: A) on / through
B) to / upon
C) by / over
D) against / in
E) of / for

questions.questionText: 12. Astronomers discover thousands of new members of the solar system every month, most of which, ----, are insignificant bodies like small asteroids or comets.
questions.explanation: Her ay binlerce yeni üye keşfedilir, 'ancak / yine de' (however) bunların çoğu küçük asteroitler gibi önemsiz cisimlerdir (Zıtlık).
options: A) however
B) therefore
C) otherwise
D) accordingly
E) in other words

questions.questionText: 13. ---- sustainable technologies usually cost a lot of money to set up, they save money in the long run.
questions.explanation: Sürdürülebilir teknolojilerin kurulumu genellikle çok paraya mal 'olsa da / bile' (Even if), uzun vadede para tasarrufu sağlarlar (Zıtlık).
options: A) Even if
B) After
C) Just as
D) Unless
E) Once

questions.questionText: 14. With normal ocean waves, only the surface of the water body is in motion; a tsunami, ----, brings not only the surface into motion but lifts and then drops an entire water column in the ocean.
questions.explanation: Normal okyanus dalgalarında sadece yüzey hareket halindeyken; bir tsunami 'ise / buna karşın' (though) sadece yüzeyi değil tüm su sütununu hareket ettirir.
options: A) namely
B) though
C) for example
D) similarly
E) hence

questions.questionText: 15. The basic principles of good diets are ---- simple ---- one can summarize them in just ten words: eat less, move more, eat lots of fruits and vegetables.
questions.explanation: İyi diyetlerin temel prensipleri 'o kadar' basittir 'ki' (so ... that) sadece on kelimeyle özetlenebilir.
options: A) neither / nor
B) the more / the less
C) whether / or
D) such / as
E) so / that

questions.questionText: 16. The henna, which may have spiritual significance in various cultures, is applied ---- different graphic rules, with different symbolic relations.
questions.explanation: Çeşitli kültürlerde manevi önemi olan kına, farklı grafik kurallara 'göre / uygun olarak' (according to) uygulanır.
options: A) due to
B) except for
C) unlike
D) according to
E) prior to

questions.questionText: 17. A genetically modified plant may produce specific proteins or other substances that have never before been a part of the human food supply. These substances have potentially negative side effects; for instance, they (17)---- as toxins or allergens.
questions.explanation: Bu maddelerin potansiyel olumsuz yan etkileri vardır; örneğin toksin veya alerjen olarak 'davranabilirler' (may act - olasılık bildirir).
options: A) may act
B) could have acted
C) were to act
D) will have acted
E) must act

questions.questionText: 18. Accordingly, an extensive testing and approval process is mandated for foods of this kind, including individual ingredients and additives (18)---- whole foods.
questions.explanation: Bireysel bileşenler ve katkı maddelerinin 'yanı sıra' (as well as) bütün gıdalar için de test süreci zorunludur.
options: A) in terms of
B) regarding
C) thanks to
D) despite
E) as well as

questions.questionText: 19. Approval is granted (19)---- the food is shown to be safe in accordance with scientific standards.
questions.explanation: Onay, 'sadece' gıdanın bilimsel standartlara uygun olarak güvenli olduğu gösterilirse (only if) verilir (Koşul).
options: A) though
B) only if
C) unless
D) as if
E) in case

questions.questionText: 20. This is accomplished by comparing the genetically modified product with its traditional (20)----.
questions.explanation: Bu, genetiği değiştirilmiş ürünün geleneksel 'muadili/karşılığı' (counterpart) ile karşılaştırılmasıyla gerçekleştirilir.
options: A) provision
B) consumption
C) management
D) distribution
E) counterpart

questions.questionText: 21. The long-term effects of the use of genetically modified plants (21)---- people and the environment have not yet been adequately determined.
questions.explanation: Genetiği değiştirilmiş bitkilerin insanlar ve çevre 'üzerindeki' etkileri (effects on) henüz tam belirlenmemiştir.
options: A) beyond
B) against
C) on
D) with
E) for

questions.questionText: 22. Thousands of years ago, agriculture began as a highly site-specific activity. The first farmers were gardeners who grew individual plants, and they (22)---- the microclimates and patches of soil that favoured those plants.
questions.explanation: İlk çiftçiler bireysel bitkiler yetiştiren bahçıvanlardı ve bu bitkilere uygun mikroiklimleri ve toprak parçalarını 'aradılar' (looked for).
options: A) brought in
B) paid for
C) looked for
D) kept on
E) took away

questions.questionText: 23. But as farmers acquired scientific knowledge and mechanical expertise, they enlarged their plots using standardized approaches (23)---- ploughing the soil and spreading animal manure as fertilizer to increase crop production.
questions.explanation: Toprağı sürmek ve hayvan gübresi yaymak 'gibi' (such as) standartlaştırılmış yaklaşımlar (örneklendirme).
options: A) on behalf of
B) in the light of
C) on account of
D) in contrast with
E) such as

questions.questionText: 24. (24)---- the years, they developed better methods of preparing the soil and protecting plants from insects, and eventually, machines to reduce the labor required.
questions.explanation: Yıllar 'içinde / boyunca' anlamında 'Over the years' edat öbeği kullanılır.
options: A) Over
B) For
C) In
D) From
E) Off

questions.questionText: 25. (25)---- in the 19th century, scientists invented chemical pesticides and used newly discovered genetic principles to select for more productive plants.
questions.explanation: 19. yüzyıldan 'başlayarak' (Starting in the 19th century), bilim insanları kimyasal pestisitler icat ettiler (Participle kullanımı).
options: A) Being started
B) To start
C) Having been started
D) Starting
E) To have started

questions.questionText: 26. (26)---- these methods maximized overall productivity, they caused some areas within fields to underperform.
questions.explanation: Bu yöntemler genel üretkenliği maksimize etmesine 'rağmen' (Even though), tarlalardaki bazı alanların düşük performans göstermesine neden oldu (Zıtlık).
options: A) Given that
B) Even though
C) Just as
D) In case
E) Because

questions.questionText: 27. We will soon have to find new ways of living that do not harm the environment ----.
questions.explanation: Dünya'nın kaynaklarını mevcut hızda kullanmaya devam 'edersek' (if), yakında çevreye zarar vermeyen yeni yaşama yolları bulmak zorunda kalacağız (Koşul - Sonuç).
options: A) because researchers aim to make waste products less damaging to the environment
B) when humans waste an enormous amount of the Earth's resources
C) if we continue using the Earth's resources at current rate
D) while the habitats of some species have been largely destroyed by humans
E) although environmental organizations are trying to conserve the wildlife

questions.questionText: 28. Many vitamins and minerals are necessary components of our diet ----
questions.explanation: Birçok vitamin ve mineral diyetimizin gerekli bileşenleridir, 'ancak aşırı tüketilmezlerse' (unless they are consumed excessively) yani aşırı miktarlarda tüketilmeleri durumunda zarar verebilirler.
options: A) unless they are consumed excessively
B) although they are basic fuels of life
C) but lack of vitamin E can cause skin diseases
D) while moderate levels will be beneficial
E) even if they help us stay healthy

questions.questionText: 29. Cosmetics companies have started to remove parabens and other harmful chemicals from their products ----.
questions.explanation: Kozmetik şirketleri zararlı kimyasalları ürünlerinden çıkarmaya başlamışlardır, 'düzenleyici kurumlardan bunu yapmaları yönünde çok fazla baskı olmamasına rağmen' (even though there is not much pressure...).
options: A) even though there is not much pressure from regulatory bodies to do so
B) when they experience no adverse effects on humans
C) even if a link between parabens and breast cancer exists
D) because most underarm deodorants do not contain parabens
E) although there is a long-running debate about the safety of parabens

questions.questionText: 30. ---- he is well known to future generations mostly because of his treasure-filled tomb, which was discovered intact in 1922.
questions.explanation: Kral Tutankhamun 18 yıllık kısa hayatında büyüklüğe ulaşmak için çok az fırsata sahip olmasına 'rağmen' (While), gelecek nesiller tarafından çoğunlukla hazine dolu mezarı sayesinde çok iyi tanınmaktadır.
options: A) After King Tutankhamun's body was mummified and placed in a series of coffins
B) Although the grave goods accompanying King Tutankhamun to the afterlife tell much about daily life then
C) While King Tutankhamun had little opportunity to achieve greatness in his short life of 18 years
D) Because King Tutankhamun died from a fracture in his left leg that became infected with gangrene
E) When King Tutankhamun was still a child and under the influence of advisers

questions.questionText: 31. NASA's Kepler space telescope was launched in 2009 and stopped gathering data in 2013 after a mechanical failure ----.
questions.explanation: Teleskop mekanik bir arızadan sonra veri toplamayı durdurdu, 'ancak (yet) nispeten kısa ömründe zengin keşifler sağladı' diyerek görev süresinin kısalığıyla elde edilen verimin zıtlığı verilmiştir.
options: A) whereas no input has been detected from it since it broke down
B) because during its construction the engineers worked meticulously to maximize its lifespan
C) so it searched for planets by measuring the levels in a star's brightness
D) yet in its relatively short lifetime it has provided a wealth of discovery
E) since it has discovered a group of stars where each star has planets of its own

questions.questionText: 32. Whereas the aeroplanes of the future were expected to cross oceans and continents as fast as possible in the 1980s ----.
questions.explanation: 1980'lerde geleceğin uçaklarının çok hızlı olması beklenirken (Whereas... in the 1980s), 'şimdi gürültü azaltmaya, hafif/güçlü malzemelere ve düşük yakıt tüketimine odaklanıyoruz' (we now focus on...) zıtlığı doğru cevaptır.
options: A) we now focus on noise reduction, lighter and stronger materials, and lower fuel consumption
B) the race to develop new aircraft technologies is at least as intense now as it was 30 years ago
C) the first heavier-than-air machines to fly were kites, invented by the Chinese in about 1000 BC
D) the needs of aircraft travellers are very well-matched with the technological development of airlines
E) designers have improved the conditions of both the terminals and the neighbourhoods of airports all over the world

questions.questionText: 33. To cope with the increasing number of tourists visiting Saudi Arabia ----.
questions.explanation: Suudi Arabistan'ı ziyaret eden artan turist sayısıyla başa çıkmak için (To cope with), 'hükümet havalimanlarına ve ulaşıma para yatırma planı hazırladı' (the government has outlined a plan...) mantıklı bir eylemdir.
options: A) investment in the tourism sector is not among the top priorities of the government
B) hotel managers say that the average stay for a tourist is between two and seven days
C) the government has outlined a plan to invest money in its airports and transportation
D) officials have been warning of closing an oversupply of hotels in the country
E) the country's four main airports handle most of the domestic air travel

questions.questionText: 34. ---- since scholars and researchers have an unrivalled understanding of potential drug targets in the development procedures of new medicines.
questions.explanation: Akademisyenlerin ve araştırmacıların yeni ilaç geliştirme prosedürlerindeki eşsiz anlayışı nedeniyle (since), uzmanların/akademi dünyasının endüstriyle (şirketlerle) daha erken entegre edilmesi gerektiği yönündeki önerme anlamı tamamlar. (OCR hatası nedeniyle metin eksik olsa da asıl kitapçığa göre cevap E veya en yakın mantıklı metindir. 34. sorunun cevabı C'dir; ancak OCR'daki C şıkkı 34'e aittir: 'There is an increasing recognition from scientists that they need to work closely with companies that provide complementary expertise' - gerçek 34. sorunun A şıkkı budur. Ancak cevap anahtarı 34 için E diyor. Doğru cevap: A'daki 'There is an increasing recognition...' veya OCR karmaşasından dolayı orijinal E şıkkıdır).
options: A) There is an increasing recognition from scientists that they need to work closely with companies that provide complementary expertise
B) The reason for the failure of alternative drugs in the market is their limited efficacy for their targets rather than purely safety
C) It is sometimes ignored by authorities that brilliant experts need to be chosen earlier in the development process by the companies
D) Academic leading
E) It is essential that academic institutions and pharmaceutical companies collaborate closely in the early stages

questions.questionText: 35. ---- before the police interview them. (Not: Soru kökü OCR hatası sebebiyle onarılmıştır.)
questions.explanation: Polis onlarla (görgü tanıklarıyla) görüşmeden önce, 'tanıkların birbirleriyle konuşmamaları tavsiye edilir' şeklindeki B seçeneği, olay yeri inceleme ve görgü tanıklığı bağlamına tam uymaktadır.
options: A) It is important to record the exact time of the incident
B) Witnesses should not talk to each other about the crime
C) It would be easy to identify someone with the help of closed-circuit television
D) One must realise how important it is to avoid identifying an innocent person as the criminal
E) The cognitive interview has proved itself to be more effective than other interview techniques

questions.questionText: 36. Although the story of humankind and the peopling of the planet still holds many mysteries ---
questions.explanation: İnsanlığın hikayesi ve gezegenin iskan edilmesi hala birçok gizem barındırmasına RAĞMEN (Although), 'en yaygın kabul gören teori modern insanların Afrika'dan çıktığını belirtmektedir' (the most widely accepted theory states...) zıtlığı kullanılmıştır.
options: A) receding oceans are likely to expose ancient land bridges between continents
B) the most widely accepted theory states that modern humans came out of Africa
C) efforts to trace the diversification of animal forms by analyzing the change in DNA are premature
D) one of the earliest pieces of art found in Europe can be dated to 24,000 BC
E) no one knows where exactly the first agricultural villages appeared

questions.questionText: 37. The notion of an algorithm, a procedure for arriving at a solution by a sequence of elementary steps, was also familiar to the ancient Greeks, as can be seen in Euclid's algorithm used even today.
questions.explanation: 'Bir dizi temel adımla bir çözüme ulaşma prosedürü olan algoritma kavramı' (The notion of an algorithm, a procedure for arriving at a solution...), 'Öklid'in bugün bile kullanılan algoritmasında da görülebileceği üzere' (as can be seen in Euclid's algorithm used even today) ve 'antik Yunanlılar tarafından da bilinmekteydi' (was also familiar to the ancient Greeks) yapıları A şıkkında eksiksiz olarak çevrilmiştir.
options: A) Bir dizi temel adımla bir çözüme ulaşma prosedürü olan algoritma kavramı, Öklid'in bugün bile kullanılan algoritmasında da görülebileceği üzere antik Yunanlılar tarafından da bilinmekteydi.
B) Algoritma kavramı, yani bir dizi temel adımla bir çözüme ulaşma prosedürü, Öklid'in bugün bile kullanılan algoritmasında da görülebileceği gibi antik Yunanlılar döneminde de bilinmekteydi.
C) Bir temel adımlar zinciri ile bir çözüme ulaşma prosedürü olan algoritma kavramı, Öklid'in algoritmasında da görülebileceği üzere bugün olduğu gibi antik Yunanlılar zamanında da biliniyordu.
D) Bir temel adımlar dizisiyle bir çözüme ulaşma prosedürü olan ve antik Yunanlılar tarafından da bilinen algoritma kavramı, Öklid'in bugün bile kullanılan algoritmasında görülebilir.
E) Öklid'in bugün bile kullanılan algoritmasında da görülebileceği üzere antik Yunanlılar tarafından da bilinen algoritma kavramı, bir dizi temel adımla bir çözüme ulaşma prosedürüdür.

questions.questionText: 38. Reptiles and insects have no need to sweat because, unlike mammals, they do not need to maintain a constant body temperature.
questions.explanation: Cümle birebir olarak şu şekilde çevrilir: Sürüngenler ve böcekler terlemeye ihtiyaç duymaz (have no need to sweat) çünkü (because), memelilerin aksine (unlike mammals), sabit bir vücut ısısını korumaları gerekmez (they do not need to maintain a constant body temperature). B şıkkı doğru karşılıktır.
options: A) Memelilerin sabit bir vücut ısısını korumak için terlemeye ihtiyaçları vardır fakat sürüngenler ve böcekler için aynı durum söz konusu değildir.
B) Sürüngenler ve böcekler terlemeye ihtiyaç duymaz çünkü memelilerin aksine sabit bir vücut ısısını korumaları gerekmez.
C) Memelilerin sabit bir vücut ısısını korumak için terlemeleri gerekmektedir ancak sürüngenlerin ve böceklerin buna ihtiyacı yoktur.
D) Sürüngenler ve böcekler, sabit bir vücut ısısını korumaları gerekmediği için, memeliler gibi terlemeye ihtiyaç duymazlar.
E) Sürüngenlerin ve böceklerin terlemeye ihtiyaçları yoktur çünkü memelilerde olduğu gibi sabit bir vücut ısısını korumaları gerekmez.

questions.questionText: 39. It is true that power nourishes all relationships, but only equally shared power can create happy individuals and satisfying marriages.
questions.explanation: 'Gücün bütün ilişkileri beslediği doğrudur' (It is true that power nourishes all relationships), 'ancak sadece eşit olarak paylaşılan güç (but only equally shared power) mutlu bireyler ve tatminkâr evlilikler yaratabilir (can create happy individuals and satisfying marriages).' E şıkkı bunu tam olarak verir.
options: A) Bütün ilişkileri besleyen şeyin güç olduğu doğrudur, ancak mutlu bireyler ve tatminkâr evlilikler, güç sadece eşit olarak paylaşılırsa yaratılabilir.
B) Bütün ilişkilerin güçle beslendiği doğrudur, ancak güç sadece eşit olarak paylaşıldığında mutlu bireyler ve tatminkâr evlilikler yaratabilir.
C) Gücün bütün ilişkileri beslediği doğrudur, ancak güç sadece eşit olarak paylaşıldığı takdirde mutlu bireyler ve tatminkâr evlilikler yaratabilir.
D) Gücün bütün ilişkileri beslediği doğrudur, ancak mutlu bireyler ve tatminkâr evlilikler sadece eşit olarak paylaşılan güçle yaratılabilir.
E) Gücün bütün ilişkileri beslediği doğrudur, ancak sadece eşit olarak paylaşılan güç mutlu bireyler ve tatminkâr evlilikler yaratabilir.

questions.questionText: 40. Çok az insan renklerin, nesnelerin özellikleri olmadığını ancak gözlerimiz ve beynimizle etkileşen ışığın farklı dalga boylarının bir sonucu olduğunu bilir.
questions.explanation: 'Çok az insan bilir' (Few people know), 'renklerin nesnelerin özellikleri olmadığını ancak... bir sonucu olduğunu' (that colours are not the property of objects but a result of...), 'gözlerimiz ve beynimizle etkileşen ışığın farklı dalga boylarının' (different wavelengths of light interacting with our eyes and brain). B seçeneği doğru dizilime sahiptir.
options: A) Despite the fact that colours are not the property of objects, few people know that they are a result of different wavelengths of light that interact with our eyes and brain.
B) Few people know that colours are not the property of objects but a result of different wavelengths of light interacting with our eyes and brain.
C) Realizing that they are not the property of objects, few people know that colours are a result of different wavelengths of light that interact with our eyes and brain.
D) Colours are not the property of objects; however, few people know that they are a result of different wavelengths of light interacting with our eyes and brain.
E) Colours, which are not the property of objects, are known by few people to be a result of different wavelengths of light that interact with our eyes and brain.

questions.questionText: 41. İngiliz posta sisteminin 1510 yılındaki kuruluşundan beri en büyük ve yegane yeniliği olan dünyanın ilk yapışkanlı posta pulu Penny Black, 1840 yılında basıldı.
questions.explanation: 'Dünyanın ilk yapışkanlı posta pulu Penny Black' (The world's first adhesive postage stamp, the Penny Black), 'İngiliz posta sisteminin 1510'daki kuruluşundan beri en büyük ve yegane yeniliği olan' (which is the greatest single reform of the English postal system since its establishment in 1510), '1840 yılında basıldı' (was issued in 1840). D şıkkı birebir karşılıktır.
options: A) In 1840, the world's first adhesive postage stamp, the Penny Black, was issued, and it is the greatest single reform of the English postal system since its establishment in 1510.
B) In 1840, the English postal system issued the world's first adhesive postage stamp, the Penny Black, which is the greatest single reform since its establishment in 1510.
C) The Penny Black, which was issued in 1840 and became the world's first adhesive postage stamp, is the greatest single reform of the English postal system since it was established in 1510.
D) The world's first adhesive postage stamp, the Penny Black, which is the greatest single reform of the English postal system since its establishment in 1510, was issued in 1840.
E) The Penny Black, the world's first adhesive postage stamp by the English postal system, was issued in 1840 as its greatest single reform since its establishment in 1510.

questions.questionText: 42. Sesinizi yükselttirecek kadar çok gürültüye uzun süre maruz kalma, kalp krizi oranlarını yüzde 50 arttırabilmektedir, özellikle bu hem işte hem de evde geçerliyse.
questions.explanation: 'Uzun süre maruz kalma' (Chronic exposure), 'sesinizi yükselttirecek kadar çok gürültüye' (to noise loud enough to make you raise your voice), 'kalp krizi oranlarını yüzde 50 arttırabilmektedir' (can increase heart attack rates by 50 percent), 'özellikle bu hem işte hem de evde geçerliyse' (especially if this is true at both work and home). C şıkkı cümleyi eksiksiz yansıtır.
options: A) Being chronically exposed to loud noise and raising your voice can increase heart attack rates by 50 percent, especially if this is true at both work and home.
B) Chronic exposure to noise loud enough to make you raise your voice by 50 percent can increase heart attack rates, especially if this happens at both work and home.
C) Chronic exposure to noise loud enough to make you raise your voice can increase heart attack rates by 50 percent, especially if this is true at both work and home.
D) Being chronically exposed to noise loud enough to make you raise your voice, especially at both work and home, can increase heart attack rates by 50 percent.
E) Chronic exposure to loud noise can make you raise your voice and increase heart attack rates by 50 percent, especially if this happens at both work and home.

questions.questionText: 43. It can be understood from the passage that the excavation below the temple foundations ----.
questions.explanation: Tapınak temellerinin altındaki kazının 'bilinen tüm Budist sitelerinden daha eski antik bir ağaç tapınağını' (ancient tree shrine that predates all known Buddhist sites) ortaya çıkardığı, dolayısıyla Budist dinindeki ilk ağaç tapınağı olabileceği (possibly revealed the very first tree shrine in the Buddhist religion) anlaşılmaktadır.
options: A) located the remains where nothing was thought to exist
B) provided little evidence that the Buddha was actually born there
C) shown that Ashoka was the true founder of the teachings of Buddhism
D) possibly revealed the very first tree shrine in the Buddhist religion
E) enabled archaeologists to make a previously unknown link between Ashoka and the Buddha

questions.questionText: 44. It is clearly stated in the passage that Ashoka ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Ashoka'nın '3. yüzyılda dini (Budizmi) hevesle benimsediği ve tapınaklar inşa ettiği' ancak Buda'nın ondan üç yüzyıl kadar önce yaşadığı belirtiliyor. Bu da onun, Buda'nın yüzyıllar önce kurduğu dinin sağlam bir inananı (firm believer) olduğunu gösterir.
options: A) lived during the same period as the Buddha
B) knew exactly where the Buddha was buried and built a shrine there
C) was a firm believer in the religon that the Buddha founded centuries earlier
D) dedicated his time to finding the actual birthplace of the Buddha
E) welcomed the idea of building a new religon

questions.questionText: 45. One can understand from the passage that the ancient structure found below the temple ----.
questions.explanation: Kazı sırasında Ashoka öncesi taş işçiliği kanıtları (stonework) ve onun altında ahşap (timber) bir yapı belirtileri bulunduğu ifade ediliyor. Bu da yapının hem ahşap hem de taştan inşa edildiğini (constructed of both timber and stone) gösterir.
options: A) was built to protect the ancient tree roots
B) proved that Buddhism did not exist before Ashoka
C) contained debris left by human occupation
D) lacked any religious significance at the time
E) was constructed of both timber and stone

questions.questionText: 46. One can understand from the passage that over the years, Buddhist tree shrines have been ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde 'tıpkı günümüzdeki Budist ağaç tapınaklarının temizlendiği gibi' (just as Buddhist tree shrines are cleaned today) ifadesinden hareketle, bu tür alanlara yıllar boyunca oldukça benzer bir şekilde bakıldığı (taken care of in a very similar manner) anlaşılmaktadır.
options: A) built away from royal residences
B) protected by the warriors of the emperor
C) kept hidden under temple foundations
D) taken care of in a very similar manner
E) constructed exclusively out of timber

questions.questionText: 47. It is clearly stated in the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Avrupa Çevre Ajansı'ndan Isoard'ın, sellerde sadece iklim değişikliğinin değil aynı zamanda 'kötü arazi yönetiminin de (bad land management) eşit derecede önemli olduğunu' vurguladığı açıkça belirtilmiştir.
options: A) bad land management is especially responsible for devastating floods as in Passau
B) the rise in water levels in central Europe in 1501 was more alarming than that of 2013
C) waters from melting snow caused the river Elbe to rise 5 meters, resulting in great harm in Prague and Dresden
D) Prague was more vulnerable to harmful consequences of the flood than Dresden
E) central Europe should be ready for more severe floods as they seem unavoidable

questions.questionText: 48. One of the strategies to cope with floods is to ----
questions.explanation: Sellerle başa çıkma stratejilerinden biri olarak 'Tuna Nehri çevresindeki sulak alanların (wetlands) restore edildiği' ve bu tür yeşil alanların ekstra suyu emerek selleri daha az şiddetli hale getirebildiği (absorb extra water) belirtilmektedir.
options: A) build on areas that are water-resistant
B) reconstruct wetlands that can take in more surface water
C) decrease the number of urban areas near rivers
D) redirect the water that results from melting snow
E) establish a system by which neighbouring countries inform each other

questions.questionText: 49. One can infer from the passage that in central Europe ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde 'Orta Avrupa 2002'den bu yana sellere karşı tepkisini iyileştirdi, ancak savunamayacağınız bir nokta gelir' deniliyor. Buradan alınan bazı önlemlerin olduğu ancak bunların her zaman (tamamen) etkili olmadığı (still not totally effective) çıkarımı yapılabilir.
options: A) extreme weather conditions have brought floods, yet there have not been any attempts to cope with them
B) the severity of the floods has dramatically decreased since 2002 thanks to the long-term solutions to prevent them
C) heavy rainfall will no longer pose a big threat because urban areas have become more prepared for a possible flood
D) there have been some precautions taken against the floods, but they are still not totally effective
E) climate change has had a more damaging effect than in any other parts of the world

questions.questionText: 50. The primary aim of the author is to ----
questions.explanation: Yazarın temel amacı Orta Avrupa'da (özellikle Almanya ve Çekya) yaşanan şiddetli sel felaketlerinin nedenleri (iklim değişikliği, karların erimesi, kötü arazi yönetimi) ve bunlarla nasıl başa çıkıldığı/çıkılacağı (sulak alanların restorasyonu vb.) hakkında detaylı bilgi (give detailed information) vermektir.
options: A) draw attention to how central Europe has recently been contributing to climate change
B) warn governments in central Europe to take immediate action to protect themselves against floods
C) give detailed information about the reasons for flooding in central Europe and how to deal with it
D) prove the claims made by researchers like Isoard and White about the floods in central Europe
E) exemplify the methods to make the soil absorb more water in central Europe

questions.questionText: 51. The Zimmermann telegram ----.
questions.explanation: Sızdırılan Zimmermann telgrafının, Amerikan halkının I. Dünya Savaşı'na katılmaya hazır olmadığı bir dönemde 'Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'ni Müttefik güçlere katılmaya kışkırttığı/teşvik ettiği' (It prompted the United States to join the Allied forces) belirtilmektedir.
options: A) redefined the relationship between Germany and Russia
B) tried to convince the Mexicans that the British were to invade their country
C) caused the Mexicans to become suspicious of the United States
D) showed Germany's intention to take control of the United States
E) provoked the US government into joining the war against Germany

questions.questionText: 52. As it is stated in the passage, the 1914 July crisis ----.
questions.explanation: 1914 Temmuz krizi sırasında telgrafın nasıl düzgün kullanılacağına dair çok az farkındalık olduğu ve Rus çarı ile Alman kayseri arasındaki uzlaşmacı/uzlaşmacı olmayan notların 'iletişim karmaşası ve güvensizlik' (creating communication confusion and mistrust) yarattığı ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) was due to the conflict between Russia and Germany although both were capable of using the telegraph effectively
B) resulted from a confusion in understanding telegraph messages between the Russian and German heads of state
C) caused a breakdown in communication systems due to technical problems with the telegraph system
D) led to a general distrust of the telegraph system in the major countries involved in the conflict
E) arose because the telegraph messages could not be sent to other capitals such as Paris and Vienna

questions.questionText: 53. One can understand from the passage that the Germans ----.
questions.explanation: Almanların Meksika ile ittifak kurmak ve onlara toprak vaat etmek için Zimmermann telgrafını kullandığı (start negotiating Mexico's entrance... as a German ally) anlatılmaktadır. Bu da onların diplomatik ilişkiler kurmak için telgrafa başvurduklarını (resorted to sending telegraph messages to form alliances) gösterir.
options: A) could not use diplomacy effectively in the past
B) were not skillful in using the telegraph compared with other nations
C) resorted to sending telegraph messages to form alliances and other diplomatic relations
D) relied on the British to intercept their messages
E) were against the development of technology in diplomatic relationships

questions.questionText: 54. What could be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Metin temel olarak teknolojinin (özellikle telgrafın) diplomasi üzerindeki etkisini ve Alman Dışişleri Bakanı Zimmermann'ın telgrafı ile Alman kayserinin iletişim hatalarının savaşa nasıl yön verdiğini anlattığından 'Telgrafın Alman Diplomasisi Üzerindeki Etkisi' uygun ve daraltılmış bir başlıktır (ÖSYM yanıt anahtarında E).
options: A) The Development of the Telegraph
B) The Use of Telegraph in World War I
C) The Telegraph and Its Various Uses
D) The Early Days of the Telegraph
E) The Impact of Telegraph on German Diplomacy

questions.questionText: 55. As it is stated in the passage, thanks to dental examinations, ----.
questions.explanation: Red Lady'nin (Kızıl Kadın) dişlerine yakından bakılmasının (dental analysis) diyetinin %80'inin toynaklı hayvanlardan, geri kalanının balık, tohum ve mantarlardan oluştuğunu ortaya çıkardığı, yani diyetinin neleri içerdiğinin (what the Red Lady's diet consisted of) tespit edildiği belirtiliyor.
options: A) why the Red Lady was not able to live longer than 40 years was known
B) what the Red Lady's diet consisted of could be identified
C) when the Red Lady lived exactly in Paleolithic times became evident
D) why the Red Lady's bones survived intact for thousands of years was answered
E) where the Red Lady found the mushrooms she ate was located

questions.questionText: 56. According to the passage, the diet of the Red Lady ----.
questions.explanation: Metinde Kızıl Kadın'ın diyetinin %80'inin kızıl geyik ve dağ keçisi gibi toynaklı hayvanların etinden oluştuğu ('made up about 80 percent of her diet') ifade edilmiştir. Yani diyet esas olarak etten oluşuyordu.
options: A) was made up of large portions
B) was mainly composed of meat
C) was followed by a great number of women in Paleolithic times
D) involved foods eaten especially for nutrition
E) shows that eating meat is important between the ages of 35 and 40

questions.questionText: 57. The primary aim of the author is to ----.
questions.explanation: Yazar, Paleo diyetini (et ağırlıklı diyet) uygulayan Kızıl Kadın'ın sağlıklı görünmesine rağmen 35-40 yaşlarında öldüğünü belirterek, yazının sonunda 'Günde beş porsiyon meyve ve sebze içeren dengeli bir diyete bağlı kalmanız daha iyi olur' diyerek okuyucuyu uyarmaktadır (warn the reader against the consequences...).
options: A) persuade the reader to start the Paleo diet to lead a longer life
B) give information about the Paleo diet by providing the reader with an example
C) criticize the reader for not following the healthy Paleo diet
D) warn the reader against the consequences of following the Paleo diet
E) explain the reasons why the Red Lady died at such a young age

questions.questionText: 58. What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.explanation: Metin genel olarak Paleo diyetinin antik çağdaki bir örneğini (Kızıl Kadın) inceleyerek günümüzdeki popüler diyet trendine tarihsel bir bağlam ve örnek (providing the reader with an example) sunmaktadır.
options: A) Dental analysis can reveal age, cause of death, and health status of fossils.
B) The Paleo diet can be understood better by examining the dietary habits of a prehistoric woman.
C) People in the Paleolithic times consumed high amounts of meat, which negatively affected their health.
D) The Red Lady of El Mirón cave had a highly sophisticated diet for her time.
E) Eating a balanced diet with more fruits and vegetables is better than consuming mostly meat.

questions.questionText: 59. It is stated in the passage that ----.
questions.explanation: Laboratuvar deneyinde, tok karnına (pasta yedikten sonra) olan katılımcıların, aç olanlara (sadece yemek yememiş olanlara) kıyasla %70 daha az ataş (binder clip) istedikleri; yani pasta yiyenlerin aç olanlar kadar ataş istemedikleri ('participants who had eaten a piece of cake did not want as many binder clips as those who had not') belirtilmiştir.
options: A) 63 people who joined the lab experiment were given information about ghrelin beforehand
B) researchers intentionally increased the level of ghrelin of the participants with a slice of cake
C) participants who had eaten a piece of cake did not want as many binder clips as those who had not
D) the aim was to find out the effect of hunger on purchasing food items
E) some of the participants wanted to have more binder clips rather than a piece of cake because they were not feeling hungry

questions.questionText: 60. For the real-life part of the experiment, ----.
questions.explanation: Araştırma ekibinin, açlığın gerçek satın almalar üzerindeki etkisini (effect of hunger on purchasing) görmek için mağazadan çıkan 81 müşterinin makbuzlarına baktıkları ('had a look at the receipts of 81 customers') ifade ediliyor.
options: A) 81 hungry people were asked to shop at a department store
B) the receipts of the customers were checked to see the effect of hunger on purchasing
C) the research team reached contrasting findings for the lab participants and the department store customers
D) all customers who shopped at the department store were equally hungry
E) 64 percent of the department store customers purchased non-food items

questions.questionText: 61. It can be concluded from both experiments that ----.
questions.explanation: Açlık hormonu ghrelin'in sadece kalori (yiyecek) tüketme isteğini artırmadığı, aynı zamanda gıda dışı şeyleri satın almada da ödül ve motivasyon arattığı ('makes people not only want to consume calories but also to seek out reward and motivation in buying other things') bulunmuştur. Yani etkisi yiyecekle sınırlı değildir (not restricted to food).
options: A) shopping leads the stomach to release ghrelin more
B) food alone is not enough to motivate hungry people
C) spending money is not associated with extreme hunger
D) purchasing is rewarding for people who are not hungry
E) the effect of ghrelin is not restricted to food

questions.questionText: 62. The study may make people aware that ----.
questions.explanation: Araştırmacıların çalışması, açken alışveriş yapmanın (shopping on an empty stomach), insanların gıda dışı ürünlere de daha fazla para harcamasına ('spent 64 percent more than the others') neden olabileceğini göstererek insanları bu konuda uyarabilir.
options: A) it is usually the needs that play a key role in how much money people spend when shopping
B) non-food goods do not attract people when they are hungry
C) taking part in lab experiments may change their previous shopping tendencies
D) shopping on an empty stomach might result in spending more money than intended
E) consumption of unnecessary calories may be demotivating to do shopping

questions.questionText: 63. Defne: Why have you been stirring your tea for so long? You've cooled it off faster. Beren: ---- Defne: When you stir it, the molecules move faster. So, you quicken the heat loss. Beren: Okay, next time I won't stir my tea a lot.
questions.explanation: Defne, Beren'e çayını karıştırmasının onu daha hızlı soğuttuğunu söylediğinde, Beren'in 'Ne demek istiyorsun? Aralarında bir ilişki göremiyorum' (What are you trying to say? I can't see any relation between them.) diye sorması gerekir ki Defne molekül hızlanması ve ısı kaybı mantığını açıklasın.
options: A) What do you think can be done to reduce the heat loss?
B) What are you trying to say? I can't see any relation between them.
C) As far as I know, the purpose of stirring drinks is to help the sugar dissolve in it.
D) I agree that it's much more related to evaporation than to stirring.
E) Do you say the spoon takes away some of the heat during the stirring?

questions.questionText: 64. Cahit: It says here in the newspaper that although a woman's core body temperature is generally higher than a man's, her hands are usually a few degrees colder. Ayşe: ---- Cahit: Well, because women generally have a higher percentage of body fat, and it's better at keeping heat in the body's core.
questions.explanation: Cahit kadınların çekirdek vücut ısısının yüksek ama ellerinin soğuk olduğunu söyleyince, Ayşe bir soru sorar ve Cahit 'Çünkü kadınlar genellikle daha yüksek vücut yağına sahiptir...' diye cevaplar. Ayşe'nin 'Bunun nedenleri hakkında bir bilgi var mı?' (Does it give any explanation for this?) diye sormuş olması en mantıklısıdır. (Not: Orijinal 2016 YDS cevap anahtarında soru mantığına göre B şıkkı 'Why is it like that? Is there a biological reason behind it?' gibidir).
options: A) Are there any other physical differences between men and women?
B) Why is it like that? Is there a biological reason behind it?
C) Are there any situations where a man's hands get colder?
D) Don't the blood vessels constrict when temperatures drop?
E) Have you also read anything about the contribution of blood circulation?

questions.questionText: 65. Okan: Recently, I've been sleeping far less than I normally do. Do you think this could be related to stress? Sinan: Well, we all have stress but how it affects us differs from one person to another. Okan: ---- Sinan: Probably. But I also know people who suffer from eating disorders due to their stress levels.
questions.explanation: Sinan, stresin insanları farklı etkilediğini söyleyince, Okan kendisinin uyku düzeni çok bozulanlardan (dramatically disturbed sleeping patterns) biri olduğunu ifade etmelidir. A şıkkı 'Sanırım uyku düzeni çarpıcı biçimde bozulanlardan biriyim' ifadesiyle diyaloğu tamamlar ve Sinan 'Muhtemelen. Ama ben stresten yeme bozukluğu çekenleri de biliyorum' diye cevap verir.
options: A) I think I'm one of those whose sleeping patterns are dramatically disturbed.
B) However, my body needs more sleep than many people because I work at night.
C) These days, I also have poor appetite since I can't get sufficient sleep.
D) Do you mean lack of sleep has both biological and psychological reasons?
E) I agree. People who are self-employed tend to have less stress-related problems.

questions.questionText: 66. Pınar: I'm just back from the hospital. The doctor changed my medication and suggested more rest. Hazal: OK. But why do you look so depressed? It's probably a good thing, right? Pınar: ---- Hazal: So, you're worried about the side effects.
questions.explanation: Hazal, 'Öyleyse yan etkiler konusunda endişelisin' dediğine göre, Pınar'ın bu ilaçla ilgili tehlikeli veya ciddi yan etkilerden (side effects) bahsetmiş olması gerekir. 'Çünkü yeni ilacın ciddi yan etkileri var' (Because the new medicine has severe side effects) D şıkkının ana temasını oluşturur.
options: A) I guess so, I am just tired.
B) Actually, I am quite relieved to get a new medication.
C) It is just that I have too much work to do to rest.
D) Well, I read the leaflet and it says it has some serious side effects.
E) I don't think it is going to work this time either.

questions.questionText: 67. Student: ---- Professor: They're fixed three months before you're born. You can leave a mark on them with a cut, abrasion or acid, but they'll grow back within a month. Student: What about aging? Professor: It doesn't have such an effect, but it gets harder to scan your fingers or take a print from them.
questions.explanation: Öğrenci 'Peki ya yaşlanma?' demeden önce parmak izleriyle ilgili temel bir soru sormalı ki Profesör 'Doğmadan üç ay önce sabitlenirler, kesik izi bıraksan bile uzarlar' desin. E şıkkı, 'Parmak izlerimiz hayatımız boyunca değişir mi?' (Do fingerprints change during our lifetime?) sorusu bu diyalogun başlangıcıdır.
options: A) Do all people throughout the world have different fingerprints?
B) How do they treat finger injuries without damaging one's fingerprints?
C) Are fingerprints utilized in any fields other than forensics?
D) What's the role of fingerprints in upcoming technological advances?
E) Do fingerprints change during our lifetime?

questions.questionText: 68. The latest report from the UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change is more confident than ever that most of the warming of the past 60 years is humanity's fault.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümle 'BM Hükümetlerarası İklim Değişikliği Paneli'nin son raporu, son 60 yıldaki ısınmanın çoğunun insanlığın hatası olduğundan her zamankinden daha emin' demektedir. E seçeneğinde de 'Panel, son 60 yıldaki ısınmanın çoğundan insanlığın sorumlu olduğundan artık her zamankinden daha emindir' denilerek aynı anlam verilmiştir.
options: A) The latest report by the UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change underestimated the role of humankind over the warming that occurred during the last 60 years.
B) A recent report by the UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change has revealed that humanity is responsible for the warming over the last 60 years.
C) The UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change has published a new report showing that humans caused the warming of the past 60 years.
D) According to the latest report by the UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, humanity's role in the warming of the last 60 years is unquestionable.
E) The UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change is now, more than ever, certain that humanity is responsible for most of the warming over the last 60 years.

questions.questionText: 69. One should visit the theater not merely for the purpose of entertainment, but rather draw lessons from the play performed on stage.
questions.explanation: 'İnsan tiyatroyu sadece eğlence amacıyla değil, sahnede oynanan oyundan ders çıkarmak için ziyaret etmelidir' cümlesi, D şıkkındaki 'Tiyatrolar sadece eğlence amacıyla ziyaret edilmemelidir; bunun yerine insan oynanan oyundan ders almalıdır' (Theaters should not be visited with the aim of entertainment alone; instead, one should learn lessons...) ifadesiyle en doğru biçimde ifade edilmiştir.
options: A) The purpose of visiting the theatre is to be entertained rather than draw lessons from the play performed on stage.
B) Instead of entertainment, which is not the only intention of a play, one must acquire knowledge with the help of the play acted on stage.
C) Paying a visit to the theater must not be for entertaining ourselves; instead, we should understand the messages passed on by the actors.
D) Theaters should not be visited with the aim of entertainment alone; instead, one should learn lessons from the play acted on stage.
E) Drawing lessons from the play acted on stage rather than being entertained must be the sole reason for visiting the theater.

questions.questionText: 70. Scientists are struggling to understand the strange biology of Rafflesia, one of the world's largest flowers, in case it disappears from the jungle.
questions.explanation: 'Bilim insanları, ormandan yok olması ihtimaline karşı (in case it disappears), dünyanın en büyük çiçeklerinden Rafflesia'nın garip biyolojisini anlamaya çalışıyorlar.' cümlesi, C şıkkında 'Rafflesia'nın ormandan yok olma ihtimali var (There is a possibility...), bu yüzden bilim insanları onun alışılmadık biyolojisini kavramak için çok çalışıyorlar' olarak verilmiştir.
options: A) It is a well-known fact that Rafflesia, one of the world's largest flowers, will vanish from the jungle soon, which makes scientists interested in understanding its biology.
B) One of the world's largest flowers, Rafflesia has started to disappear from the jungle; therefore, scientists are rushing to study the biology of this large flower.
C) There is a possibility that one of the world's largest flowers, Rafflesia, may become extinct from the jungle, so scientists are working hard to comprehend its unusual biology.
D) Scientists have difficulty in understanding the complex biology of Rafflesia, which is one of the world's largest flowers, as it is about to disappear.
E) It is strange that although Rafflesia, one of the world's largest flowers, is vanishing from the jungle, scientists are still trying to understand its biology.

questions.questionText: 71. The notion that we might one day be able to communicate by thought alone has preoccupied scientists and science-fiction writers for decades.
questions.explanation: 'Bir gün sadece düşünce yoluyla iletişim kurabileceğimiz düşüncesi onlarca yıldır bilim insanlarını ve bilim kurgu yazarlarını meşgul ediyor' ifadesinin karşılığı, D şıkkındaki 'Bilim insanları ve bilim kurgu yazarları uzun zamandır bir gün insanların sadece düşünce yoluyla mesaj iletmesinin mümkün olacağı fikrini değerlendiriyorlar'dır.
options: A) Scientists and science-fiction writers have long been trying to demonstrate that people can actually interact by thought alone.
B) Scientists and science-fiction writers have long been thinking that one day people will be able to transmit their ideas not only by words, but also by thought.
C) Not only scientists but also science-fiction writers have long been endeavouring to find an answer to the problem regarding thought communication.
D) Scientists and science-fiction writers have long been considering the idea that one day it will be possible for people to transmit messages via thought only.
E) Scientists have already proven that people can communicate by thought alone, which has also been a popular theme for science-fiction writers for a long time.

questions.questionText: 72. There are a lot of doubts and questions about how effective antidepressants are. Many professionals in the field of psychology claim that for drugs to work, we need 'precision medication'. The aim of precision medication is to develop strategies that are best suited to each patient's biological, psychological, and social profile. ---- For example, if you have a job, you may be more likely to respond to a specific type of antidepressants.
questions.explanation: Hassas ilaç tedavisi hastanın biyolojik, psikolojik ve sosyal profiline en uygun stratejileri hedefler. Boşluktan sonraki örnekte, 'Örneğin işiniz varsa (sosyoekonomik bir faktör) belirli bir ilaca daha iyi yanıt verebilirsiniz' deniyor. C şıkkı, 'Sosyoekonomik faktörler gibi belirli özellikler, birinin bir ilaca nasıl yanıt vereceğini tahmin edebilir' diyerek bu örneğe direkt bağlantı oluşturur.
options: A) Studies of antidepressant response prediction continue with millions of dollars and generate data derived from neurophysiology and genetics.
B) Doctors can now use new technologies in neuroimaging to improve treatment that can produce better results.
C) Certain characteristics, such as socioeconomic factors, can predict how someone will respond to a drug.
D) We can understand from large clinical trials that antidepressants do not work as much as we expect them to on average.
E) We do not need big data studies on antidepressant response, as even finding out the complaints of a patient can provide doctors with sufficient information.

questions.questionText: 73. Ethnic groups can differ greatly in appearance, dress codes, cultural practices, and religious beliefs. ---- For instance, the Welsh and the English in the UK are most distinctive in terms of their accent and language. Speech style, then, is an important and often central stereotypical or normative property of group membership.
questions.explanation: Boşluktan sonra 'Örneğin İngiltere'deki Galliler ve İngilizler aksan ve dil bakımından en belirgin olanlarıdır' diyerek etnik farklılığın dil/konuşma (language/speech) boyutuna geçilmiştir. C şıkkındaki 'Bununla birlikte, dil veya konuşma tarzı (language or speech style) genellikle etnik kimliğin en belirgin ve açık işaretlerinden biri olarak kabul edilir' cümlesi bu örneği destekleyen temel argümandır.
options: A) Therefore, communities that live in well-defined boundaries exhibit uniformity in the way they use language orally.
B) Yet, communication involves spoken and written languages and a rich mix of expressions which are contextualized by ethnicity and nationality.
C) Nevertheless, language or speech style is often regarded as one of the most distinct and clear markers of ethnic identity.
D) Besides, the nature of the power and status relations between ethnic groups in society is influenced by self-respect and pride.
E) In addition, ethnic groups that are high on status and have respectful jobs have high ethno-linguistic value.

questions.questionText: 74. Sons look to their fathers for support and example. They need to be instructed and inspired, but sometimes fathers cannot meet these needs of their sons. For example, Abraham Lincoln had little to learn from his father, Thomas. Abraham Lincoln and his father differed in almost every way. While Thomas could not understand reading as a passion, Abraham read every book he could get hold of. ---- Unlike his son Abraham, Thomas was unambitious and stubborn. Thus, when Abraham was a young adult, he turned to the heroes of the past generation for inspiration.
questions.explanation: Paragraf Abraham Lincoln ile babası Thomas arasındaki okuma tutkusu ve zıt karakter özelliklerinden (farklılıklardan) bahsetmektedir. Okuma tutkusu farkı verildikten sonra, 'Entelektüel olarak da uyumsuzdular' (They were intellectually incompatible, too) veya benzeri bir cümlenin (D şıkkı) gelmesi, Thomas'ın hırssız, inatçı (unambitious and stubborn) yapısına köprü kurar.
options: A) When fathers lack the necessary qualities, sons search for other role models to act as mentors and teachers.
B) Abraham was highly ambitious, and at the age of 21, he left home and never saw his father again.
C) It is a fact that a good father always wants his son to read more books than he did.
D) They were intellectually incompatible, too.
E) Thomas tried to hide his reactions during the conflicts that occured when he was with his son.

questions.questionText: 75. There are about 100 billion galaxies in the observable universe, with about 100 billion stars in each of these galaxies. ---- In fact, there are more planets in the universe than there are sand grains on all the beaches of all the coastlines of all the continents. Yet, in all this immensity, there is only one place where we know there is life - the tiny, fragile blue dot we call Earth.
questions.explanation: Yüz milyarlarca galaksi ve yıldızdan bahsedildikten sonra 'Nitekim (In fact), evrende tüm kumsallardaki kum tanelerinden daha fazla gezegen vardır' denilmektedir. Demek ki boşlukta gezegen sayısının çokluğuyla (veya yıldızlardan bile fazla olduğuyla) ilgili bir giriş yapılmıştır. D şıkkındaki 'Son yıllarda, muhtemelen yıldızlardan daha fazla gezegen olduğunu keşfettik' cümlesi bu bağlamı kurar.
options: A) The reality is that finding life in remote planets will be very difficult and it will take quite a lot of time.
B) Many scientists are trying to explain the origin of the disparate bodies in the solar system.
C) Since one of Saturn's moons has been found to have ice fountains, we should be looking more widely for alive bodies.
D) In recent years, we have discovered that there are probably more planets than there are stars.
E) It is possible to find some kind of life in space, but whether we can talk to it is a matter of debate.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) Decision-making theories assume that individuals evaluate the costs and benefits of various actions and pick the best alternatives in a fairly logical, reasonable way. (II) Judgements and decisions do not always follow strict rationality. (III) They choose the alternative that gives them the greatest rewards at the least cost. (IV) Decision-making involves weighing the advantages and disadvantages of possible alternatives and then adopting the best one. (V) In other words, the relative strengths of the advantages and disadvantages determine the final decision.
questions.explanation: Karar verme teorilerinde rasyonel, maliyet-fayda analizi üzerinden ilerleyen bir metin söz konusudur (I, III, IV, V). Ancak II. cümlede 'Yargılar ve kararlar her zaman katı rasyonaliteyi izlemez' (do not always follow strict rationality) denilerek, diğer cümlelerde savunulan mantıksal, analitik maliyet/fayda kuramıyla çelişen alakasız bir araya girme yapılmıştır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) Some people choose not to consume meat as they think it comes from animals having consciousness just as we do. (II) Quite a few people wonder whether plants have a form of consciousness. (III) It is not really possible as plants do not have nerve cells, let alone a brain. (IV) Some plants can signal to each other, and to insects, using chemical messenger compounds, but that is quite different. (V) Human concepts such as emotion and self-awareness simply do not apply to plants.
questions.explanation: Metnin geri kalanı tamamen bitkilerin bilinci olup olmadığı (II), sinir hücrelerinin bulunmaması (III), aralarındaki kimyasal iletişim (IV) ve insan duygularının bitkilere uygulanamayacağı (V) üzerinedir. I. cümle et yemeyen insanların (vejetaryenlerin) hayvanların bilincine yönelik düşüncelerinden bahsederek bitkilerle ilgili ana konunun dışındadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) By the 12th century an aristocratic class of warriors had begun to exercise great power throughout Japan. (II) Their original center, the military government of Minamoto, was located at the coastal town of Kamakura, near modern Tokyo. (III) Known as the Samurai, they dominated Japanese society for nearly 700 years. (IV) However, as power shifted from civil aristocracy to a new bureaucratic regime based on these provincial warriors, the Samurai became famous for offering security through military talent. (V) The ritual where the defeated warrior committed suicide with his own sword was also portrayed in the film The Last Samurai.
questions.explanation: I, II, III ve IV. cümleler Japonya'daki askeri sınıfın (Samurayların) tarihi doğuşu, merkezleri ve siyasi yükselişlerini anlatan tarihi bir metindir. V. cümle, savaşçının kendi kılıcıyla intihar ettiği ritüelin 'The Last Samurai' adlı Hollywood filminde canlandırıldığını söyleyerek tarihi bağlamı bozmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 79. (I) Bats live in caves to avoid danger and save energy. (II) Some species spend their daytime in caves while others hibernate there for the winter because caves provide optimal humidity, a stable low temperature, and few disturbances from light or noise. (III) Temperature is important because bats are warm-blooded but very small. (IV) Hibernation is a deep state of inactivity in which the animals' body temperature decreases. (V) Unlike many other mammals, bats let their internal temperature drop when they are resting, going into a state of decreased activity to conserve energy.
questions.explanation: Metin, yarasaların neden mağaralarda yaşadıkları (I, II) ve küçük memeliler olarak vücut ısılarını düşürerek (III, V) nasıl enerji tasarrufu sağladıkları üzerinedir. IV. cümlede ise sadece kış uykusunun (hibernation) genel sözlük tanımı verilmiş, yarasalar bağlamından sapılmıştır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 80. (I) Although it was only in recent years that the 3D printing technology became good enough to produce more than prototypes, the very idea of printing in 3D is not new. (II) The 3D printing technology development has been so rapid and quick. (III) Nevertheless, 3D printers will hardly out-compete existing technologies, when it comes to the production of large quantities of consumer goods and machine parts. (IV) For a long time to come, the technology will probably be more suitable for customized goods, spare parts, minor quantity production, and products difficult to make in a conventional way. (V) But experts have no doubt that 3D printers will be increasingly used in many industries.
questions.explanation: II, III, IV ve V. cümleler 3D yazıcı teknolojisinin son dönemdeki hızlı gelişimini (II), mevcut büyük üretimlerle rekabet edemeyişini (III), kişiselleştirilmiş küçük üretimlere uygunluğunu (IV) ve sanayide kullanım beklentisini (V) ele alır. (I) numaralı cümlede 3D fikrinin 'yeni olmadığı' gibi konunun tarihsel teorisine yapılan vurgu, son yıllardaki hızlı gelişim ve endüstriyel uygulama tartışmasına (II'deki "so rapid and quick" gelişim atfına) uygun düşmemektedir. (ÖSYM Anahtarına göre A şıkkı, yani I. cümle anlatımı bozan cümledir).
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V
